bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
stage="/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed"
test -f "$stage/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" || exit 41
test -f "$stage/src/telegram/stickerSales.mjs" || exit 42
printf 'STAGE_PATH_EXISTS=YES\n'
if git -C "$stage" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 printf 'STAGE_GIT=YES\n'
 printf 'STAGE_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)"
 printf 'STAGE_BRANCH=%s\n' "$(git -C "$stage" branch --show-current)"
 printf 'STAGE_DIRTY_COUNT=%s\n' "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain | wc -l)"
else echo STAGE_GIT=NO; fi
if test -f "$stage/deploy/.env"; then echo COMPOSE_DOTENV=PRESENT; else echo COMPOSE_DOTENV=MISSING; fi
if test -f "$stage/.env"; then echo ROOT_DOTENV=PRESENT; else echo ROOT_DOTENV=MISSING; fi
if grep -Fq "stickerLandingPanel" "$stage/src/telegram/stickerSales.mjs"; then echo STAGE_RETURN_FIX=ACTIVE; else echo STAGE_RETURN_FIX=MISSING; fi
if grep -Fq "uniqueAcknowledgedAppend" "$stage/src/stickers/packRegistration.mjs"; then echo STAGE_APPEND_FIX=ACTIVE; else echo STAGE_APPEND_FIX=MISSING; fi
if (cd "$stage/deploy" && docker compose -f compose.videobot.poll.yaml config --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1); then echo COMPOSE_CONFIG=PASS; else echo COMPOSE_CONFIG=NEEDS_EXISTING_ENV; fi
echo STAGE_DEPLOY_PREFLIGHT=DONE
